The Stethoscope Acoustic Performance Evaluation Tool is a versatile Engineering and Quality Assurance test tool that can be used to measure, compare and evaluate acoustic performance of a stethoscope. It includes custom desktop computer software and customized hardware mounted in a noise-reduced enclosure, connected through a USB port. It works by supplying an audio signal to the stethoscope chestpiece, while monitoring amplitude at the binaural: scope performance may be gauged by frequency response and amplitude. The amplitude is measured in calibrated decibels (dB). Can be used in two modes: Swept Frequency Graphing, and Fixed Frequency Testing. We also manufacture an industrial grade stethoscope valve test fixture. It's used to validate the seal and air release valve on a manual stethoscope. They are built tough for the professional musician, but are affordable for aspiring newcomers. It works with all midi to parallel interfaces. The mMS reads type 0 midi files from a local SD memory card, decodes and sequences the midi information and streams it to an instrument.
